MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS a
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE l.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,a+collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS ks
UNWIND ks AS k
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT k) AS people WHERE size(people)>=2
UNWIND people AS id
RETURN DISTINCT id, 'person' AS kind

MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS a
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE l.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,a,collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS b
WITH i,pr,[x IN a+b WHERE x IS NOT NULL AND x<>''] AS ks
UNWIND ks AS k
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT k) AS people WHERE size(people)>=2
UNWIND people AS pid
WITH collect(DISTINCT pid) AS ps, collect(DISTINCT pr.projectKey) AS prs
UNWIND ps+prs AS id
RETURN id

MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS a
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE l.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,a,collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS b
WITH i,pr,[x IN a+b WHERE x IS NOT NULL AND x<>''] AS ks
UNWIND ks AS k
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT k) AS people WHERE size(people)>=2
UNWIND people AS pid
WITH collect(DISTINCT pid) AS ps, collect(DISTINCT pr.projectKey) AS prs
UNWIND ([x IN ps|{id:x,kind:'person'}]+[x IN prs|{id:x,kind:'project'}]) AS r
RETURN r.id AS id, r.kind AS kind
